title.zh: C08 P-XXL 突破群雄重围，13 分力压 Player5 与 Sol
title.en: C08 P-XXL navigates 8-team gridlock to top Sol and Player5

desc.zh: 8 队同图极限绞杀，Player5 与 Sol 均斩获 10 分，C08 P-XXL 凭借高质量意图预测规避阻截，狂揽 13 分独占鳌头。
desc.en: In an intense 8-way melee where Player5 and Sol tied at 10, C08 P-XXL capitalized on superior opponent modeling to claim 13 points.
